items.title: Pay late-filing surcharge (Verspaetungszuschlag)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Posting day printed on letter: 27.01.2025 (Monday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so this is the posting day. The letter was posted after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: 27.01.2025 + 4 days = 31.01.2025 (Friday). This is a Finanzamt, so if that 4th day fell on a weekend or holiday it would shift to the next working day, but 31.01.2025 is an ordinary Friday, so delivery stands at 31.01.2025. The one-month payment period starts the day after delivery (Sec 108 Abs. 1 AO with Secs 187, 188 BGB) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number; since February 2025 has no 31st day, it ends on the last day of that month: 28.02.2025. That day is a Friday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so no shift under Sec 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed.

items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the surcharge assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist der Einspruch zulaessig. Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behoerde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Same delivery date as above: posted 27.01.2025 (Monday), deemed delivered on the 4th calendar day, 31.01.2025 (Friday), which is not a weekend or holiday so it is not adjusted (the Finanzamt rule under Sec 108 Abs. 3 AO only shifts the delivery day itself if it falls on such a day). The one-month Einspruch period under Sec 355 Abs. 1 AO runs from the day after delivery (Sec 108 Abs. 1 AO, Secs 187, 188 BGB) and ends on the corresponding day of the following month; since 31 February does not exist, it ends on the last day of February 2025, i.e. 28.02.2025 (Friday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under Sec 108 Abs. 3 AO applies.
